notes:
Inbound via self-serve signup + contact form. Small D2C accessories brand (totes, small leather goods). Found us via comparison blog; created account and ran quick test using hosted API free credits.

- Interested primarily in: product Q&A widget (site-side), automated short descriptions for 12k SKUs (catalog enrichment), and a light chat assistant for returns/help.
- Traffic profile: baseline modest (100-200 reqs/day) with bursty spikes during weekend promos (observed 8x spike during flash sale). Concerned about cold-start latency and throttling.
- Cost sensitivity: high — founders want predictable per-month spend, likely to commit once costs < $1k/mo for initial features.
- Model preference: open-model compatibility preferred; "smallish" latency-optimized model for Q&A, embeddings for search/rerank. Willing to try quantized variants.
- Security/compliance: public cloud OK. Request SSO (SAML) for admin console and audit logs for events. Data residency is not strict.

AE notes from 2026-02-28 call: "We just need something that doesn't go down during promos — last year our third-party chat went offline during a sale and conversion dropped 12%." Founder: wants a fast POC.

Operational notes: SE Marco asked for sample CSV (12k SKUs) + 200 seed Q/A pairs; team to provide by 2026-03-12. Provided pricing deck link and onboarding doc.

POC success criteria (agreed): p95 query latency < 300ms for product Q&A; embeddings similarity recall > 0.75 on 200 eval pairs; monthly cost projection documented and accepted by founder.

Slack-style shorthand from follow-ups: "founder + ops on call; wants card billing; legal flagged DPA; pricing OK if < $900/mo in POC projection."
